models.buildAdmission: prepare-local-ocr-assets.mjs uses exact size and SHA-256 for cached and downloaded bytes, bounded streaming into a fixed-size buffer, a 60-second fetch timeout and redirect refusal. No user PDFs enter preparation.
models.runtimeAdmission: local-ocr-models.ts reads exact-size local assets into owned storage and verifies SHA-256 before passing provided byte data to loadLanguage. The editor supplies only eng or fra, gzip:false, cacheMethod:none, lstmOnly:true. It uses no credentials, redirects, model URL payload or worker model cache. The 180-second worker deadline and cancellation abort the pending fetch; stop reasons survive asynchronous races.
models.trustLimit: This verifies the allowed model bytes before native parsing, not their internal safety. It does not protect a compromised application bundle, same-origin executable code or substituted native core, and does not establish that arbitrary traineddata is safe. Native Init bindings and traineddata/LSTM parsers still need separate review and fuzzing.

sourceReview.finding: The worker accepts provided model data as well as fetchable language names. The editor now provides admitted bytes before native initialization. The unchanged application core's Init2/3/4 and wider ABI are not cleared by caller-side checks. In the research candidate only, unused Init2 and standalone config-file reads now abort. Both Init3/4 remain: the generated JS dispatches empty config to Init3 even when the worker supplies four arguments. Native directory validation is recorded below, distinct from deeper component parser clearance.

researchNativeModelDirectory.finding: The pinned loader sizes component vectors from unvalidated offsets, permits zero-entry tables and indexes empty vectors. This is a source-level finding, not a CVE or claim that an untrusted model can reach the editor's hash-admitted path.
researchNativeModelDirectory.change: Hash-bound research modification checks a no-allocation directory preflight before TFile/component allocation. Accept only 1..24 known slots, a complete table, -1 absence sentinels, at least one nonempty component, first offset exactly after the directory, strictly increasing offsets inside the buffer and at most 16 MiB raw data. Both byte orders are supported. File loading refuses empty/oversized data before indexing/narrowing. Original copyright/licence headers and explicit modification comments are retained.
researchNativeModelDirectory.verification: The actual added preflight runs under ASan/UBSan with warnings-as-errors, both byte orders, directory truncations, 50176 one-byte mutations and 10000 deterministic mutations. A research-only export invokes the real patched TessdataManager::LoadMemBuffer for 1970 valid/invalid controls and mutations, including both exact bundled language models. The three disabled model/config bindings trap in fresh WASM instances with owned APIs/in-bounds storage. English/French recognition and independent scan/export tests are separate regressions.
researchNativeModelDirectory.limitations: This validates the directory and bounds copied components, not LSTM/DAWG/unicharset contents, arbitrary pointer provenance, later native result allocation or every entry path. The size cap in Init is after its existing file-reader allocation; the editor independently bounds/validates bytes before native initialization. No candidate core replaced app assets and no Windows policy was bypassed.

nativeResultBoundary.validation: Require arrays/records, bounded collections, string words, finite baseline and ordered finite boxes inside the raster. Normalize only admitted geometry; reject invalid output with content-free errors. Blank entries count toward the budget before filtering.
nativeResultBoundary.limitsOfReview: These checks bound traversal and composition in the parent, not native recognition, result serialization/allocation or worker-to-parent structured clone. Worker termination and memory limits do not constitute whole-native security clearance.

researchApiReduction.scope: Exact optional native PDF-renderer signatures/bodies, three unused model/config entries and eleven raw component/image/iterator output getters abort in the research candidate before argument access. Existing 25 raw/ownership, six alternate image-input and four legacy traps remain. The worker requires Init3/4, AnalyseLayout and JSON/UTF8 text, which remain unchanged. No research core is installed into the app; retained pointer/string ownership and native result allocation still need review.

verification.scope: Purpose-created synthetic fixtures in isolated Chromium; visible scan bytes render identically before/after invisible text export. No customer documents, public accuracy claim, OCR reconstruction, general corpus equivalence or native WebView2 certification. Unit digest mock covers control flow only; browser integrity tests use actual WebCrypto and model bytes.

remainingGates: Exact native fork/API ownership and traineddata/LSTM/PNM parser review and broader native sanitizer/fuzz coverage.
Final candidate source-to-binary integration, notices/security approval and baseline/SIMD performance/platform policy; candidate is not adopted.
